technical-summary: Reviewed consolidation of conditional HIP tuning candidates. THA09/14 moved to THA16 with full dispatch-optimization gates after trace attribution; THA19-23 moved into THA16 as unselected operator-family gates behind THA18 and exposed critical-path evidence; THA24/25 moved into THA15 with candidate provenance, correctness, resource and replay gates.
